text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
..."Super Blazing Storm Delinquent Legend!" all chapters free?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: This manga... I feel like I remember seeing it in my dad's room a long time ago...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Whoa!? Seriously!?
The head bancho is showing up now!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after encountering delinquent manga for the first time in ages, Espoir City got hooked and ended up staying up late.
